Noah Rivera: Kicking off Helios Health onboarding. Quick brief: they want Redwood for patient Q&A summarization + embeddings for search. Primary ask: secure onboarding (HIPAA scope), enablement for care ops, and clear renewal signals. 30-min sync at 10am PT today.
Priya Singh: thanks Noah. Who's on Helios side?
Noah Rivera: Helios contacts: Maya (product mgr), Oliver (SRE), and Tessa (Legal). Maya is joining this thread.
Maya Chen: hi all 44b. Confirming peak load ~200 concurrent agents, nightly batch embedding jobs, and retention constraints. Security questionnaire coming.
Daniel Brooks: noted. Security + retention will affect our private options. For success criteria can we list measurable items?
Noah Rivera: Proposed success criteria:
- Console admin trained and able to create/revoke API keys
- End-to-end embedding pipeline in sandbox (nightly job)
- p95 latency for lookup <300ms under test load
- No PII leakage in sample outputs per automated check
Priya Singh: timeline draft:
Week A: legal & security intake + sandbox access
Week B: integration of realtime endpoints + nightly jobs
Week C: load test, retention policy finalize, enablement runbook
Week D: handoff + exec check-in
Maya Chen: blocker: their Security Ops requires an external pentest report before sandboxing. Also retention clause needs custom language.
Noah Rivera: Action items:
- Maya: send security contact + sample data schema by EOD
- Daniel: scope private deployment options and estimate cost impact by Thu
- Priya: set up sandbox org + invite Helios users by Wed
- Noah: open renewal-risk note in CRM, tag as "time-sensitive"
OnboardBot: New onboarding created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/3110009876 4c4 checklist added: security intake, sandbox, pentest, enablement call
Maya Chen: I'll attach the data schema and the questionnaire answers to the folder after the call.
Daniel Brooks: FYI I'll run a quick traceroute + perf baseline once we have test creds.
Priya Singh: Scheduling daily 10am stand for first 7 business days. Invite sent.
Noah Rivera: Renewal risk: procurement review is scheduled in 5 weeks. If we can't show nightly job success and admin enablement before then it's a HIGH risk. Tagging for CS Ops attention.
Maya Chen: Understood. We'll prioritize security items. Appreciate the daily sync.
Noah Rivera: Thanks team 44d. I'll post meeting notes and recording here after 10am.
